xmldoc.short_description: Encode text into International Morse code.

param_input_item.param_description: the message to encode (case-insensitive): a char row vector, a scalar string, a string array or a cellstr (whose elements are joined by a space).

param_output_item.param_description: a character row vector, the Morse code.
a cellstr of the unique characters not found in the table.

description.p: The mapping is the International Morse code table (ITU-R M.1677-1): letters, digits, the standard punctuation and a few accented letters. Within a word the letters are joined by 'LetterSeparator' and the words by 'WordSeparator'. Characters that are not in the table are dropped ('skip'), raise morse:unknownCharacter ('error'), or are copied verbatim as their own token ('keep', for display only).
With 'Prosigns' true (the default), a group written between angle brackets is keyed as a prosign, that is the letters run together with no gap: morse.encode('<AR>') is '.-.-.'. See morse.prosigns.

xmldoc.bibliography: ITU-R Recommendation M.1677-1, International Morse code.
